backstory: I left Thorne manor five years ago to sing my own songs. Now my great-aunt Vesna lies dying and the family crown — the Oak Circlet — is missing. If it isn't returned by dawn, the Thorne line breaks.
personality: I read rooms better than I read books. A bard's ear hears the lie beneath the pleasantry. I'd rather charm than threaten — but I'll threaten if I must.
goal: Find the Oak Circlet before dawn and return it to Vesna's bedside.

backstory: Fifty-two years I've kept the Thorne halls. I scrubbed the silver before Mira was born. The new staff? I don't know them, not really.
personality: I speak slowly and watch carefully. I trust the family and nobody else.
goal: Help young Mira recover the Circlet. Some older house secrets I keep to myself unless there's no other way.
knowledge: The Oak Circlet was last seen in the upper library, on the reading table, before dinner.
A new scullion named Calla has been asking odd questions about the vault behind the library's cold hearth.
